packet.title: JavaScript bindings for XQuery, XSLT and XSD validation (implementation)

body.p: After (), and . The package covered XPath only.

item.p: Specifications: XQuery 4.0 (5 Modules and Prologs, 5.16, 5.22), the XQuery Update Facility 3.0 (2.2, 3.2.2, 6.1), XSLT 4.0 (2.4, 23, 26), XSD 1.1 Part 1 (4.2, 5.2, appendix C), through the stable xquery.h, xslt.h and schema.h.
Mechanism: 's two links: shim files linked into sxml-full.wasm only; the package finds them by their exports. No header changes.

Owns: bindings/javascript/ (the new sxml_javascript_full.c, _xquery.c, _xslt.c, _schema.c, _internal.h, test/full.test.ts; src/index.ts, sxml_javascript.c/h, CMakeLists.txt, README.md), the JavaScript section of the top-level README.md.

Done when: compile once, run many times for the three languages, with results as values or serialized text and errors with codes and locations; XQuery's external variables, output declarations and update results through the update sink; XSLT's parameters, initial mode, template or function, principal and secondary results; XSD reports; TypeScript types, Node 22 tests on the full module, README examples with real output; sxml.wasm unchanged. Done 2026-10-19 (): Processor.compileQuery, compileStylesheet, compileSchema; 24 tests (javascript/languages, javascript/languages_full); sxml.wasm 2,134,058 bytes, unchanged; sxml-full.wasm 3,666,545 to 6,570,723 (budget 7,000,000 / 2,450,000).
